name: Webpage to Markdown
description: Convert any webpage to clean markdown with one click. Extract article content and download or copy as markdown.
author: BillionSaas

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; img-src * data: blob: 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'
